summary: The study focuses on the fabrication and characterization of atomic layer deposited beryllium oxide (BeO) as a gate dielectric for InGaAs MOS devices. BeO was deposited using a novel ALD process with dimethyl beryllium as a precursor. The results show that BeO provides better electrical performance, lower leakage current, and improved interface quality compared to Al2O3. The ALD process also demonstrated good thermal stability and self-cleaning effects on the InGaAs surface.
